lines.en: label dormwar10:
scene goodmorningio1
I wake up to nothing at all.
lines.zh: 我在一片虚无中醒来。

lines.en: A horrible start to the day.
lines.zh: 这可真是糟糕的一天之始。

lines.en: I faintly recall getting up in the middle of the night to blast the AC, but it has now reached a point where I am so cold that I don’t even want to move.
lines.zh: 我隐约记得半夜起来把空调开到最大，可现在已经冷到我连动都不想动了。

lines.en: So I lie here and die.
lines.zh: 所以我就躺在这儿等死。

lines.en: I lie here underneath a beige ceiling, accompanied by the four paperthin walls propping it up-
lines.zh: 我躺在一片米白色的天花板下，陪着我的只有撑起它的四层薄如纸的墙——

lines.en: And die.
lines.zh: 然后死掉。

lines.en: Goodbye, world.
lines.zh: 再见了，世界。

lines.en: I stare up and try to connect this morning’s vision with the one I’m most accompanied with.
lines.zh: 我抬头望着天花板，试着把今早看到的这片景象和我最常见到的那片对上号。

lines.en: This ceiling is lower than the one in my room, which means that if I were to continue growing, I’d hit my head on this one before the other.
lines.zh: 这片天花板比我房间里的低，也就是说，要是我继续长高，会先撞到这一片，而不是另一片。

lines.en: But that’s just how verticality works.
lines.zh: 不过垂直性本来就是这样。

lines.en: The higher something is, the safer it is.
lines.zh: 越高的东西就越安全。

lines.en: So we should all ascend and ascend and ascend, placing ourselves on top of the highest things we can find.
lines.zh: 所以我们都该往上爬、往上爬、再往上爬，把自己放到能找到的最高的东西顶上。

lines.en: Because only then can we look down at those who have had their growth stunted and laugh a hearty laugh, pressing our hands against the skin of our arms to scare away the goosebumps.
lines.zh: 因为只有这样，我们才能低头看着那些发育被压制的人放声大笑，同时把手压在手臂的皮肤上，把鸡皮疙瘩赶走。

lines.en: I have never liked the way the world looks right after opening my eyes.
lines.zh: 我从来都不喜欢刚睁开眼时世界的样子。

lines.en: It’s one of the saddest views of all.
lines.zh: 那是最让人难过的景象之一。

lines.en: Because even though it is wonderful to breathe and wonderful to see-
lines.zh: 因为尽管能呼吸很美好，能看见也很美好——

lines.en: It is not wonderful to be.
lines.zh: 但“存在着”这件事并不美好。

lines.en: But I am.
lines.zh: 可我确实存在着。

lines.en: : Oh, you’re up.
lines.zh: : 哦，你醒了。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio2
: Yo.
: Io.
lines.zh: : 是 Io。

lines.en: : What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Avoiding female contact.
lines.zh: : 躲开女性接触。

lines.en: : Yes, but...when did you even get here? I went to sleep pretty late.
lines.zh: : 是吗，可你到底是什么时候来的？我睡得挺晚的。

lines.en: : Sometime between like, 2:00 AM and 3:00 AM I think?
lines.zh: : 大概在凌晨两点到三点之间吧。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. And how exactly did you get into my room?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。那你到底是怎么进我房间的？

lines.en: : I told the people at the front desk that you were my dad and they just gave me a key.
lines.zh: : 我跟前台的人说你是我爸，他们就直接给了我房卡。

lines.en: : Crafty, right?
lines.zh: : 很狡猾吧？

lines.en: : I’m glad you didn’t have the chain lock attached because that would have meant I’d need to go home and get my tools, which would be significantly harder to explain to the employees.
lines.zh: : 还好你没挂安全链，不然我就得回家拿工具，那样要跟店员解释起来可就难多了。

lines.en: : You were that desperate to get away from your floormates, huh?
lines.zh: : 你就那么想躲开同楼层的室友啊？

lines.en: scene goodmorningio3
: Don’t tell me you’re surprised by that.
lines.zh: : 别告诉我你很意外。

lines.en: : I’m not. But I {i}am{/i} surprised that you didn’t just go back to the dorm instead.
lines.zh: : 我不意外。我只{i}是{/i}意外你没干脆回宿舍去。

lines.en: : To tell you the truth, so am I.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我自己也意外。

lines.en: : But it was somewhere around like 1:30 that I started thinking about stuff, and among all of those thoughts was this one guy who looks kind of like you.
lines.zh: : 不过大概一点半的时候我开始胡思乱想，在那一堆念头里，有个长得有点像你的男人。

lines.en: : Kind of?
lines.zh: : 有点？

lines.en: : Kind of. You look pretty different without your glasses.
lines.zh: : 有点。你不戴眼镜的样子差别挺大的。

lines.en: : And you look different in...whatever you’re wearing right now.
lines.zh: : 而你穿着……现在这身衣服的样子，也挺不一样的。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio4
: What’s wrong with what I’m wearing right now?
lines.zh: : 我现在穿的这身有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : Nothing. It's fine.
lines.zh: : 没什么。挺好的。

lines.en: : If you close your eyes, I can put my normal clothes back on. I got changed while you were sleeping and just threw them all at the foot of your bed.
lines.zh: : 你闭上眼睛，我就能把平时的衣服换回来。你睡着的时候我换了衣服，全扔在你床尾了。

lines.en: : At least have the courtesy to wake me up next time.
lines.zh: : 下次至少行行好把我叫醒吧。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio5
: You did wake up. You stepped on my leg on your way to the air conditioner before deciding that you wanted to freeze the two of us to death.
lines.zh: : 你是醒了啊。你去开空调的路上踩到我腿了，然后就决定要把我们俩一起冻死。

lines.en: : I’m sure I was only subconsciously trying to freeze myself to death. I didn’t realize you were here.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定我只是下意识想把自己冻死。我不知道你在这儿。

lines.en: : And literally stepping on me wasn’t enough to give that away?
lines.zh: : 你真的踩了我一脚，这还不够让你察觉吗？

lines.en: : I...was apparently very tired.
lines.zh: : 我……显然是太累了。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio6
: Well, since you’re awake now, how about we start drafting our escape plan?
lines.zh: : 行吧，既然你醒了，我们要不要开始拟定逃跑计划？

lines.en: : Escape plan?
lines.zh: : 逃跑计划？

lines.en: : Yeah. Where we ditch the rest of this competition thing and go hang out at an amusement park or something.
lines.zh: : 对啊。我们甩掉剩下的比赛，去游乐园什么的玩。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’m allowed to do that, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我不能那么做。

lines.en: : What do you mean you’re not allowed? You’re a grown man and you make your own rules.
lines.zh: : 什么叫不能？你是个成年人，规矩是你自己定的。

lines.en: : What do you have to gain by letting a bunch of annoying [teens] drag you around like you’re some kind of dog all day?
lines.zh: : 让一群烦人的[teens]整天把你当狗一样牵来牵去，你能得到什么？

lines.en: : What do I have to gain by ditching them to be with you?
lines.zh: : 那我甩掉她们来陪你，又能得到什么？

lines.en: scene goodmorningio7
: One whole Io. Redeemable wherever Ios are accepted.
lines.zh: : 一整个 Io。凡接受 Io 的地方均可兑换。

lines.en: : So basically nowhere because Io is trash and her value keeps getting lower and lower with each passing day.
lines.zh: : 所以基本上哪儿都不行，因为 Io 是垃圾，而且她的价值一天比一天低。

lines.en: : Yeah, that doesn’t sound like a great investment.
lines.zh: : 嗯，听起来不是什么好投资。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio6
: What if I add like...a snack to the deal? You like potato chips?
lines.zh: : 那我要是再加点……零食呢？你喜欢薯片吗？

lines.en: : Let’s go get potato chips. And soda. And then ride some big fucking rollercoaster or something.
lines.zh: : 我们去买薯片吧。还有汽水。然后去坐那个他妈的大过山车什么的。

lines.en: : You have too much energy for it being this early...
lines.zh: : 这么早你就这么有精神啊……

lines.en: : In fact, why are you even awake? Didn’t you say you didn’t fall asleep until like 2:00 or 3:00?
lines.zh: : 话说，你怎么会醒着？你不是说你到两三点才睡着的吗？

lines.en: : Ish. But it’s not really easy to sleep when A: you stepped on me and really hurt my leg. And B: I had to sleep on the floor.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。不过这种情况下真的很难睡着：一、你踩了我，把我腿踩得挺疼的；二、我得睡地板。

lines.en: : Like, yeah, I’ve got a futon and stuff...
lines.zh: : 就是说，我确实有褥子什么的……

lines.en: : But that bed looks crazy comfortable and it gave me one of those inner struggle things where I had to think about whether or not it would be cool to join you in there.
lines.zh: : 可那张床看起来舒服得要命，害我内心挣扎了半天，一直在想爬进去跟你一起睡会不会显得很酷。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have minded. Though, it definitely would have been a little more confusing to wake up to that when I feel like I haven’t seen much of you at all lately.
lines.zh: : 我不会介意的。不过，考虑到我最近见你的次数少得可怜，醒来看到你躺旁边肯定会更让人懵。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio8
: And whose fault is that?
lines.zh: : 那怪谁呢？

lines.en: : You realize that you’re one of the two people I actually enjoy spending time with, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你是少数几个我真心喜欢待在一起的人之一吧？

lines.en: : And Uta’s been kind of all over me lately, so it would be nice if you’d come see me more to balance out the scale and blah blah blah Io is needy.
lines.zh: : 而且 Uta 最近老是缠着我，所以你要是能多来看看我、把天平平衡一下就好了——诸如此类，反正 Io 就是这么黏人。

lines.en: : Speaking of Uta, did you ever tell her where you ran off to? I know she was looking for you last night.
lines.zh: : 说到 Uta，你有没有告诉她你跑去哪儿了？我知道她昨晚在找你。

lines.en: : In fact, where {i}did{/i} you run off to?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你{i}到底{/i}跑哪儿去了？

lines.en: : I think some of Ayane’s blood splashed onto me after she was decimated at the maid cafe, so I wound up going back to my aunt’s to take a bath.
lines.zh: : Ayane 在女仆咖啡厅被血洗之后，好像有点血溅到我身上了，所以我就回我姑姑家洗了个澡。

lines.en: : Also figured that Yuki might be there since it was a Saturday night and she’s normally free around then. But nope, no dice.
lines.zh: : 我还想着周六晚上 Yuki 大概会在那边，她那会儿一般都有空。结果呢，扑了个空。

lines.en: : Probably because she was with me.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为她跟我在一起。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio9
: Yuki was?
lines.zh: : Yuki 跟你在一起？

lines.en: : Yeah, I ran into her while I was walking around.
lines.zh: : 对，我散步的时候撞见她了。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So you two didn’t like, make plans or anything. You just bumped into each other.
lines.zh: : 哦，这样。所以你们俩没有……约好什么的，只是碰巧遇上。

lines.en: : How do you find the time to cultivate relationships with so many people, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你哪来的时间跟这么多人经营关系啊？

lines.en: : Easy. Time is unlimited.
lines.zh: : 简单。时间是无限的。

lines.en: : That’s debatable.
lines.zh: : 这可不好说。

lines.en: : Time is a human construct with no direct intrinsic value, so it’s only as unlimited as we humans want or imagine it to be.
lines.zh: : 时间只是人类的构造物，本身没有直接的内在价值，所以它能有多无限，全看我们人类想让它有多无限。

lines.en: : Also, the fact that time itself could be considered unlimited has no bearing on the time that you, a middle aged male, have left to live your life.
lines.zh: : 再说，时间本身可以被视为无限，这跟你——一个中年男性——剩下多少时间过日子毫无关系。

lines.en: : Cherish every second. Celebrate what it means to live. Vote Io.
lines.zh: : 珍惜每一秒。庆祝活着的意义。投 Io 一票。

lines.en: : ...Vote Io for what?
lines.zh: : ……投 Io 一票，投去做什么？

lines.en: : Dunno. Just sounded like a good campaign slogan.
lines.zh: : 不知道。只是听起来像个不错的竞选口号。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio6
: Anyway, is it cool if I use your shower to get ready for the amusement park? I don’t really wear makeup so I’ll only be like ten minutes tops.
lines.zh: : 总之，我能用你的淋浴准备一下去游乐园吗？我不怎么化妆，所以最多也就十分钟。

lines.en: : Io, I’m not going to the amusement park with you. I have to get up and...let girls fight over me or something.
lines.zh: : Io，我不会跟你去游乐园的。我得起床去……让女生们为我争个你死我活什么的。

lines.en: : But I’m fighting for you right now. Why does anyone else need to be involved?
lines.zh: : 可我现在就在为你争啊。为什么非得把别人扯进来？

lines.en: : Because they made plans to fight for me and didn’t just sneak into my room in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 因为她们是为了我才订好计划的，而不是半夜偷偷溜进我房间。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio10
: Guh. Who would have thought that being assertive would spell my downfall when it only seems to make you like everyone else more?
lines.zh: : 呃。谁能想到，主动出击反倒成了我的败笔——明明别人这么干，只会让你更喜欢她们。

lines.en: : It’s not a downfall and I don’t like you any less than I did before. I just can’t do what you want me to do right now.
lines.zh: : 这算不上败笔，我对你的喜欢也一点没比以前少。我只是现在没法照你说的做。

lines.en: : But you know what you {i}can{/i} do?
lines.zh: : 不过你知道你{i}能{/i}做什么吗？

lines.en: scene goodmorningio5
: Please please please please please please {i}please{/i} do not ask me to join in on any of the weird “festivities” our class has planned for today.
lines.zh: : 求求求求求求{i}求{/i}你别叫我去参加我们班今天安排的那些奇怪“庆祝活动”。

lines.en: : It sucks enough that I’m already showing up for like half of them.
lines.zh: : 光是有一半的活动我都得露面，就已经够糟的了。

lines.en: : Expecting me to join in and talk to people on top of that is just like...yeah, no.
lines.zh: : 在这基础上还要我跟人互动、跟人说话……那就是……不行。

lines.en: : Like, I said maybe two sentences to that Chika girl during the sports thing yesterday and even that was more associating than I planned on doing the whole weekend.
lines.zh: : 就说昨天运动那场，我跟那个叫 Chika 的女生说了大概两句话，就这都比我打算在整个周末里跟人打交道的量还多。

lines.en: : Why not Yumi, then?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不是 Yumi？

lines.en: scene goodmorningio11
: Oh, right. You weren’t there for it when we were choosing the competitions, but I’m pretty sure Yumi wants to fight me.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我们选比赛项目的时候你不在，但我挺确定 Yumi 想跟我打。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Probably because I’m like half her size and she has anger issues that likely stem from repeated emotional abuse at a [young]age.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为我只有她一半大小，而她的暴躁问题很可能源自[young]时期反复遭受的情感虐待。

lines.en: : Why do you have to be so real all the time?
lines.zh: : 你为什么总是这么一针见血？

lines.en: scene goodmorningio7
: Real? I’m more fake than like, all of the people I call out for {i}being{/i} fake on a daily basis.
lines.zh: : 一针见血？我比我每天骂{i}假{/i}的那些人还要假。

lines.en: : It’s a very complicated situation, but I’d be more than happy to explain it to you on a rollercoaster.
lines.zh: : 情况很复杂，不过我很乐意在过山车上给你解释清楚。
: Io……

lines.en: scene goodmorningio12
: Hah...Yeah, yeah. I know.
lines.zh: : 哈……好好好。我知道。

lines.en: : There won’t {i}be{/i} a rollercoaster because I was too spontaneous for you and didn’t fill out the proper “Sensei request” forms.
lines.zh: : 过山车{i}是{/i}没戏了，因为我对你来说太心血来潮，也没填好正规的“Sensei 申请表”。

lines.en: : I’ll just take my broken leg and hobble on over to the ER all by myself. Maybe someone there will want to ride the teacups with me.
lines.zh: : 那我就拖着我那条断腿，自己一瘸一拐去急诊好了。说不定那儿有人愿意陪我坐旋转茶杯。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio13
: If that’s not housekeeping, this is going to be really hard to explain.
lines.zh: : 如果那不是客房服务，这事可就难解释了。

lines.en: : Sensei? Are you awake yet?
lines.zh: : Sensei？你醒了吗？

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound like housekeeping.
lines.zh: : 听起来不像客房服务。

lines.en: scene black
I hop off of the bed, making sure I don’t step on Io again, and gesture at her to get up as well...
lines.zh: 我跳下床，小心别再踩到 Io，同时示意她也起来……

lines.en: scene goodmorningio14
: Ugh...
: I’m going to have to hide, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 我得躲起来，是吧？

lines.en: : Would you prefer to stay and chat with her about why you’re in my room?
lines.zh: : 还是你想留下来，跟她聊聊你为什么在我房间里？

lines.en: scene goodmorningio15
: Sure. Why not? Invite her on in and I’ll tell her all about why I prefer being with you over like 99.99%% of the world.
lines.zh: : 好啊。有何不可？请她进来，我就好好跟她说说，为什么比起世界上 99.99%% 的人，我更喜欢跟你待在一起。

lines.en: : Or alternatively, you could grab your clothes off of the floor and go...hide under a desk or something.
lines.zh: : 或者，你可以把地上的衣服捡起来，去……躲在桌子底下什么的。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio14
: Hey...is everything okay? Do I hear someone else in there?
lines.zh: : 嘿……还好吗？我怎么听见里面有别人？

lines.en: : What about the futon? I don’t have time to get rid of both.
lines.zh: : 那褥子怎么办？我没时间把两样都收掉。

lines.en: : Just...
: Here, I’ll help.
lines.zh: : 来，我帮你。

lines.en: scene black
I put on my glasses and grab the futon off the floor.
lines.zh: 我戴上眼镜，把地上的褥子抓起来。

lines.en: Io scurries over to where she threw her clothes, following my lead and tossing everything into the bathroom at the same time as me.
lines.zh: Io 小跑到她扔衣服的地方，跟着我的动作，和我同时把所有东西一股脑扔进浴室。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Io. It must be done.
lines.zh: : 抱歉了，Io。非这样不可。

lines.en: : What must be-
lines.zh: : 什么是非这样——

lines.en: : Hey! Sensei! I would have...gone in on my own!
lines.zh: : 喂！Sensei！我自己会……自己进去的！

lines.en: I throw Io into the bathroom as well and finally move to the door to let Chika in.
lines.zh: 我把 Io 也扔进浴室，然后终于走到门口去给 Chika 开门。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio16
: Good morning~
lines.zh: : 早上好~

lines.en: : Good morning. What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 早上好。你在这儿干嘛？

lines.en: : I just came to say that since we didn’t really get to talk at all yesterday.
lines.zh: : 我就是过来看看，毕竟昨天我们都没怎么好好说话。

lines.en: : What took so long to get to the door? I didn’t wake you up, did I?
lines.zh: : 怎么这么久才来开门？我没吵醒你吧？

lines.en: : You did, actually. But it’s okay.
lines.zh: : 你确实吵醒了。不过没关系。

lines.en: : You should probably get going before someone else has the same idea as you and-
lines.zh: : 你大概该走了，免得别人也跟你想一块儿去——

lines.en: : Joke’s on you. I set an alarm extra early just so I could be the one who actually got to come wake you.
lines.zh: : 你失算了。我特意把闹钟调得特别早，就是为了能抢到叫你起床这个名额。

lines.en: : And sure, the rest of the girls will be waking up soon-
lines.zh: : 当然了，其他女生也快醒了——

lines.en: scene goodmorningio17
: But that doesn’t mean we don’t have time to have a little fun of our own.
lines.zh: : 但这不代表我们没时间先自己找点乐子。

lines.en: : Uhh...
Chika digs two of her fingers into the waistband of my sweatpants and attempts to tug me close to her.
lines.zh: Chika 把两根手指伸进我运动裤的腰带里，想把我拽过去。

lines.en: I refuse to move forward for obvious reasons, but this just makes her more aggressive as she inserts her entire hand into my pants.
lines.zh: 出于显而易见的原因我不肯往前，可这反而让她更来劲，干脆把整只手都伸进了我裤子里。

lines.en: : Do guys always get hard while they sleep or did I just get lucky today?
lines.zh: : 男生睡觉的时候都会硬吗，还是说我今天运气好？

lines.en: : This...really isn’t the best time...
lines.zh: : 这……真的不是时候……

lines.en: : Mnh~ No...it’s probably not.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼~不……大概确实不是。

lines.en: : But I want it to be~
lines.zh: : 可我希望是呢~

lines.en: Chika reluctantly lets go of me and switches back into wholesome mode, her primary setting.
lines.zh: Chika 不情不愿地松开我，切换回她的默认模式——清纯模式。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio16
: I guess just being here to wake you up is enough. We don’t have to do anything else right now if you don’t want to.
lines.zh: : 我想，能来叫你起床就已经够了。你要是不想，我们现在也不用做别的。

lines.en: : Besides, I need to go and get ready for my contest anyway. It’s gonna be a good one.
lines.zh: : 再说，我还得去准备我的比赛呢。那场比赛会很精彩。

lines.en: : Oh yeah?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？

lines.en: : Oh yeah. I won’t tell you what’s in store since it’s supposed to be a surprise, though.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过我不能剧透，因为要保持神秘感。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio18
: But let’s just say that being your girlfriend gives me a preeeeeetty big advantage in it.
lines.zh: : 不过这么说吧——作为你的女朋友，我在那场比赛里有相当——大的优势。

lines.en: And of course she has to say that while Io is just one paperthin wall away. Great.
lines.zh: 而她偏偏要在 Io 只隔着一层薄墙的时候说这种话。真是太好了。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio16
: Anyway, good morning and I love you. Try not to miss me too much before my contest, okay?
lines.zh: : 总之，早上好，我爱你。我比赛之前别太想我哦？

lines.en: : Or do. In fact, you probably should, since I’ll be missing {i}you{/i} a whole lot.
lines.zh: : 或者想吧。其实{i}你{/i}大概该想，因为我会非常非常想你。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: I’ll see you later, Chika.
lines.zh: : 回头见，Chika。

lines.en: : Mhm~ See you later, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼~回头见，Sensei。

lines.en: : I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: scene black
scene goodmorningio19
Io comes out of the bathroom a full minute after Chika leaves, but doesn’t say anything once she does.
lines.zh: Chika 走后整整一分钟，Io 才从浴室里出来，可出来以后一句话也没说。

lines.en: I guess it’s not really easy finding words at a time like this, though.
lines.zh: 我想，这种时候确实很难找到合适的话说。

lines.en: Or ever, really.
lines.zh: 或者说，任何时候都难。

lines.en: So I just let her stand there for a little while longer.
lines.zh: 所以我就让她再多站一会儿。

lines.en: And I stand there with her.
lines.zh: 而我也陪她站在那儿。

lines.en: Not saying anything, and barely thinking anything other than “Fuck. This sucks.” which, in my defense, it does.
lines.zh: 什么都没说，脑子里除了“操。糟透了。”之外几乎什么都没想——而我得为自己辩解一句，它确实糟透了。

lines.en: It sucks for everyone involved.
lines.zh: 对牵涉其中的每个人来说都糟透了。

lines.en: Woe is me, having so many girls who like me as much as they do.
lines.zh: 唉，我真惨，居然有这么多女生这么喜欢我。

lines.en: Or, in some cases-
lines.zh: 或者，在某些情况下——

lines.en: : ...Girlfriend?
lines.zh: : ……女朋友？

lines.en: In some cases, love.
lines.zh: 在某些情况下，是爱。

lines.en: : It’s...a really complicated misunderstanding.
lines.zh: : 这……是个很复杂的误会。

lines.en: : Of course it is. Girls are the fucking worst.
lines.zh: : 那当然。女生真是他妈最讨厌了。

lines.en: : Just tell her you’re not dating if it’s becoming too much of a problem.
lines.zh: : 要是麻烦太大，你就直接跟她说你们没在交往不就行了。

lines.en: : It’s a little more complicated than that...
lines.zh: : 事情比那要复杂一点……

lines.en: scene goodmorningio20
: Well...tell me about it, then.
lines.zh: : 那……你跟我说说呗。

lines.en: : I don’t really think it’s something you should be getting involved in.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这事你不该掺和进来。

lines.en: : And it’s not something I particularly {i}want{/i} to be involved in...but it beats the hell out of everything I’m going to be thinking for the rest of the day now.
lines.zh: : 我也不是特别{i}想{/i}掺和……不过总比我接下来一整天都要想的其他事情强多了。

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: scene goodmorningio21
: {i}Her?{/i}
: {i}That{/i} was your choice?
lines.zh: : 你选的是{i}她{/i}？

lines.en: : A generic tanned, bleach blonde gyaru?
lines.zh: : 一个烂大街的、晒黑了又漂了金发的辣妹？

lines.en: : Chika’s not generic, she’s-
lines.zh: : Chika 才不烂大街，她——

lines.en: : She’s been gone for like five minutes and I can still smell her fucking perfume.
lines.zh: : 她都走了五分钟了，我还是能闻到她那该死的香水味。

lines.en: : What the hell, Sensei? You're so much better than that.
lines.zh: : 搞什么啊，Sensei？你明明值得更好的。

lines.en: : Is that really the kind of girl you’re into? Is it because she, like...put out right away or something?
lines.zh: : 你真的喜欢那种女生吗？就因为她……很快就肯上床之类的？

lines.en: : It’s not that. I just-
lines.zh: : 不是那样。我只是——

lines.en: : Is it just blondes in general? Is that your thing? Because there was that other girl who you already-
lines.zh: : 还是说只要是金发就行？你就好这口？因为之前还有那个女生，你已经——

lines.en: : Io, correct me if I’m wrong, but haven’t you said before that who I “see” is none of your business?
lines.zh: : Io，要是我说错了你纠正我，但你以前不是说过，我跟谁“在一起”不关你的事吗？

lines.en: scene goodmorningio22
: It’s {i}not{/i} any of my business! You can do whatever you want and I don’t have the right to get upset over it!
lines.zh: : 是{i}不{/i}关我的事！你想干什么就干什么，我没有资格为此生气！

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : But I’m apparently going to get upset over it anyway!
lines.zh: : 可我显然还是会为此生气！

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because I’m sensitive! And a hypocrite! You know these things!
lines.zh: : 因为我敏感！而且双标！这些你都知道的！

lines.en: : I do. Which is why I’m not holding this against you and lecturing you the way I did when you talked down on Ayane without getting to know her.
lines.zh: : 我知道。所以我没有因此怪你，也没有像上次你还没了解 Ayane 就贬低她时那样教训你。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio23
: Sensei, I don’t know what kind of person you want me to be...but I don’t want to get to know these people.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我不知道你想让我成为什么样的人……可我不想去了解这些人。

lines.en: : Then don’t. No one is forcing you to.
lines.zh: : 那就别了解。没人逼你。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio24
: Do you...
lines.zh: : 你能不能……

lines.en: : Can we go to the amusement park now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在能去游乐园了吗？

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : I didn’t think so.
lines.zh: : 我就知道不行。

lines.en: : It's really funny, you know.
lines.zh: : 说起来真可笑，你知道吗。

lines.en: : I told myself when I left the bathroom that I’d just pretend I didn’t hear anything and that nothing ever happened-
lines.zh: : 我从浴室出来的时候就告诉自己，就当什么都没听见，什么都没发生过——

lines.en: : But of course I decided to be {i}me{/i} again and just started venting without even thinking about how it would make you feel.
lines.zh: : 结果{i}我{/i}当然还是又做回了自己，想都不想你会有多难受就开始发泄。

lines.en: : I’m sure you have your reasons for whatever you’re doing with that girl.
lines.zh: : 我相信你和那个女生之间那样做，肯定有你的理由。

lines.en: : And I’m sure you have your reasons for the way you’re reacting to it.
lines.zh: : 我也相信你会这么反应，肯定有你的理由。

lines.en: : And I’m sure that I’ll wind up telling you all about them at the worst or most inappropriate time one of these days.
lines.zh: : 我也敢肯定，总有一天我会在最糟糕、最不合时宜的时候，把这些理由全倒给你听。

lines.en: : And I’m sure that I’ll be right there to listen.
lines.zh: : 我也敢肯定，到时候我一定会在那儿听着。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio25
: And I’m sure that you’ll hate me for it.
lines.zh: : 我也敢肯定，你会因此讨厌我。

lines.en: : And I’m sure that I won’t.
lines.zh: : 我也敢肯定，我不会。

lines.en: : I think I’m going to...skip taking a shower this morning since I took a bath like, less than twelve hours ago.
lines.zh: : 我想我……今早就先不洗澡了，毕竟我不到十二个小时前才泡过澡。

lines.en: : You can...go on ahead, though. If you need to meet up with everyone, I mean.
lines.zh: : 不过你……可以先走。我是说，如果你得去跟大家会合的话。

lines.en: : If it’s okay with you, I’d...like to try sleeping for a little while longer in here since I didn’t get much last night.
lines.zh: : 如果你不介意的话，我……想在这儿再睡一会儿，毕竟昨晚没怎么睡。

lines.en: : Do you need me to carry you to the bed? I’m not sure how broken your leg is.
lines.zh: : 要我抱你到床上去吗？我不知道你的腿伤得有多重。

lines.en: : Not so broken that I need you to carry me. I’ll be okay.
lines.zh: : 还没到需要你抱的程度。我没事的。

lines.en: : Then yeah. Feel free to spend as much time in here as you want.
lines.zh: : 那好吧。你想在这儿待多久都行。

lines.en: : Just don’t answer the door for anyone.
lines.zh: : 只是别给任何人开门。

lines.en: : Not even housekeeping?
lines.zh: : 连客房服务也不开？

lines.en: : Not even housekeeping.
lines.zh: : 连客房服务也不开。

lines.en: scene goodmorningio26
: And...uhh...I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 还有……呃……对不起。

lines.en: : For snapping again, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说，又冲你发火了。

lines.en: : I don’t want you to hate me just because I found out something I probably wasn’t supposed to know.
lines.zh: : 我不想因为我知道了某些我大概不该知道的事，就被你讨厌。

lines.en: : It was bound to happen sooner or later. But it’s really not as serious as she made it sound and-
lines.zh: : 这事迟早会让你知道的。不过真没她说得那么严重，而且——

lines.en: : I’m sorry if this is blunt, but I really don’t care.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我说话直，但我真的不在乎。

lines.en: : Which means I really don’t want to hear anymore about it.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，我真的不想再听了。

lines.en: : Which means I should probably stop talking.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，我大概该闭嘴了。

lines.en: : We both should. We’re not very good at it.
lines.zh: : 我们都该闭嘴。我们都不太擅长这个。

lines.en: : No, we’re really not.
lines.zh: : 对，真的不擅长。

lines.en: : I...guess this is the part where you leave, then?
lines.zh: : 那我……猜这就到了你要走的时候了？

lines.en: : Well, yes. But there is one glaring issue.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是的。不过有个很要命的问题。

lines.en: : Is it that you’re still wearing sweatpants?
lines.zh: : 是你还穿着运动裤这件事吗？

lines.en: : It is that I’m still wearing sweatpants.
lines.zh: : 就是我还穿着运动裤。

lines.en: : Well, don’t mind me. I’ve already seen your penis, so-
lines.zh: : 嗯，别管我。你的鸡巴我早就看过了，所以——

lines.en: I begin to take my pants off and-
lines.zh: 我开始脱裤子，然后——

lines.en: scene goodmorningio27
: That was a joke, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 那是开玩笑的，Sensei！

lines.en: : I mean, I {i}have{/i} seen it. But only through the camera! And...I’ll just go back into the bathroom and...wait or something.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我{i}确实{/i}看过。但只是通过摄像头！而且……我还是回浴室去……等着什么的吧。

lines.en: : Oh. Sure. Whatever is more comfortable for you.
lines.zh: : 哦。好啊。你觉得怎么自在怎么来。

lines.en: : Thanks...but can you...open the door maybe?
lines.zh: : 谢谢……不过你能不能……把门打开？

lines.en: : Open it yourself. I stopped taking my pants off the second you flinched.
lines.zh: : 你自己开。你一缩我就停下来了。

lines.en: : If I open my eyes and your pants are off, I’m going to be extremely disappointed.
lines.zh: : 要是我睁开眼发现你已经把裤子脱了，我会非常失望的。

lines.en: : That hurts my feelings more than you could ever imagine.
lines.zh: : 这句话伤我感情的程度，你根本想象不到。

lines.en: scene black
Io opens her eyes and quickly reaches for the handle of the bathroom door, throwing herself inside without so much as looking at me.
lines.zh: Io 睁开眼，飞快地伸手去够浴室的门把手，连看都不看我一眼就一头钻了进去。

lines.en: I take a moment to get dressed and hear the sound of the shower starting up just as I’m about to leave the room.
lines.zh: 我花点时间穿好衣服，就在准备离开房间时，听见了淋浴的声音。

lines.en: Which means, of course, that Io can’t even follow through on smaller promises to herself.
lines.zh: 这当然意味着，Io 连对自己许下的小小承诺都做不到。

lines.en: Either that or she just...decided that she wanted to take a shower. Which is also a reasonable thing to think and something I probably should have done this morning before leaving.
lines.zh: 要么就是她……决定要洗个澡。这也是合理的想法，而且我今天早上出门前大概也该洗一个。

lines.en: But I highly doubt Io would let me shower {i}with{/i} her at this point.
lines.zh: 不过我很怀疑 Io 现在会让我{i}跟她一起{/i}洗。

lines.en: Especially not after today.
lines.zh: 尤其是经过了今天之后。

lines.en: Or, who knows? Maybe she’d be more into it now that she’s gotten a direct glimpse into some of the “competition.”
lines.zh: 或者，谁知道呢？也许她已经直接见识到了一部分“竞争对手”，现在反而更有兴趣了。

lines.en: Still...I’m not happy about how things played out with Chika this morning.
lines.zh: 不过……我对今早和 Chika 之间发生的那些事并不开心。

lines.en: Would I have been happy if we were alone and a small, green-haired girl had {i}not{/i} snuck into my room the night prior?
lines.zh: 如果只有我们两个人，而昨晚也{i}没有{/i}一个绿色头发的小个子姑娘溜进我房间，我会开心吗？

lines.en: Most likely.
lines.zh: 大概会。

lines.en: But things didn’t play out that way.
lines.zh: 可事情并不是那样发展的。

lines.en: And I have once again managed to walk the tightrope that is adultery (Or at least partial adultery since we’re not dating in my eyes) without falling off and plummeting to the ground below.
lines.zh: 而我再一次走过了出轨（或者至少是部分出轨，毕竟在我眼里我们并没有在交往）这根钢丝，没有掉下去摔个粉身碎骨。

lines.en: I exit the room without a smile on my face, leaving another smileless girl behind in the shower.
lines.zh: 我面无表情地走出房间，把另一个同样没有笑容的女孩留在了淋浴间里。

lines.en: And hope that everything turns out okay.
lines.zh: 然后希望一切都会好起来。
